_comment: Q25c: does the chart guidance need its own tool? best (get_chart_guidance(type), a REQUIRED first call) vs best-inline-guidance (temporary: no guidance tool; render_chart called with only `type` renders nothing and returns the same guidance; a wrong shape is refused with the shape and an example either way). Everything else byte-identical. Registered before the run with a decision rule.
n_per_cell: 10 on the 12 non-bar/line paths, 5 on bar and line
protocol: Portable harness, 26 waves of 5+5 interleaved, 0 retries.
headline: Its own tool wins. Correct on the 12 non-bar/line paths: best 119/120, inline 113/120. Inline fell below 9/10 on two paths (treemap 7/10, boxplot 8/10), a gap of 3 on treemap. Bar and line 10/10 in both.

The pointer to a mode of the same tool is followed far less: a type-only call before the first chart 78/120, against get_chart_guidance 110/120 (inline below 6/10 on pie, radar, funnel, polarArea). The model tries the payload straight away, is refused (16 runs; 15 recover), or falls back to bar or line.
Nothing is saved: the 932 characters fewer in tools/list are offset, plausibly by the extra refused calls. Median tokens on the 12 paths best 24196, inline 24236 (+0.2%); both a median of 2 calls.
A type-only call never rendered (P4 holds).

predictions.P1: FALSIFIED — inline below 9/10 on 2 paths (treemap 7, boxplot 8); gap 3 on treemap.
predictions.P2: FALSIFIED — type-only call first below 6/10 on pie (3), radar (4), funnel (4), polarArea (5); 0/10 on bar and line.
predictions.P3: FALSIFIED — inline +0.2% median tokens over the 12 paths.

decision: best keeps get_chart_guidance (P1 and P3 fail).

guidance_first.best-inline-guidance: 78/120 (pie 3, doughnut 6, radar 4, polarArea 5, bubble 10, scatter 7, sankey 8, matrix 8, treemap 6, boxplot 7, funnel 4, graph 10)
